name: Jiaozuo Super Cloud Computing Digital Economy Industrial Park
notes: Henan Daily reported the Jiaozuo Digital Intelligence Center started construction in Oct. 2024 with full completion planned by end-2026; DVBCN's 2024 Henan key-project summary says the project includes a 1000P regional computing service center, data storage buildings, cloud application base, power supply and distribution support, and 55,000 sq m gross floor area. Electrical capacity not disclosed.

name: Jiyuan City Cloud Computing Center / China Mobile Jiyuan IDC data center room
notes: Jiyuan municipal government article says Jiyuan Mobile invested CNY 100 million in an IDC data center room, officially named Jiyuan City Cloud Computing Center in 2018, with more than 6,000 sq m area and IDC/cloud services for government and enterprise users. Electrical capacity not disclosed.

name: People's Data Zhongyuan Cloud Data Center (Disaster Recovery)
developer: People's Data / project company not specified
notes: Jiyuan Development Reform and Statistics Bureau said it was advancing preliminary work for the People's Data Zhongyuan Cloud Data Center (disaster recovery) and supporting window-guidance filings for computing infrastructure; a 2024 Jiyuan implementation plan supports construction of a compute-storage-operation integrated intelligent computing infrastructure. Electrical capacity not disclosed.

name: Kaifeng Green Intelligent Computing Center Phase I
developer: Kaifeng Intelligent Computing Big Data Industry Development Co., Ltd.
notes: Project filing was approved Jan. 26, 2025 with planned Feb. 2025 tendering. Phase I investment estimated at CNY 1.2926792 billion, about 39 mu site, 24,336.88 sq m above grade plus 2,764.83 sq m underground, 1,200 cabinets, and about 2000P computing scale. Electrical capacity not disclosed.

name: Henan Mobile Luohe Data Center Room
notes: Dahe/Dahanet reported Henan Mobile invested in and built a Luohe data center room that can accommodate standard racks and supports local data center and computing-network services; over 20 enterprises and public institutions had migrated business to the cloud. Electrical capacity and rack count not disclosed in accessible text.

name: China Mobile Luoyang Call Center Phase II / Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Listed among Henan's 2024 second-batch key new-infrastructure projects; total building area about 35,000 sq m, mainly including an intelligent computing center, production complex, and support facilities. A 2023 provincial digital-economy plan also named China Mobile (Henan Luoyang) Data Center among projects to accelerate. Electrical capacity not disclosed.

name: Nanyang Regional Computing Center
developer: Nanyang municipal government / operators to be determined
notes: Nanyang's official AI+ action plan sets a goal to build one regional computing center by 2028 and to improve AI computing supply using existing public/private cloud resources and provincial computing vouchers. No specific site, MW, rack count, or operator disclosed.

name: Pingdingshan Intelligent Computing Center / Baigui Lake Science and Innovation City project
developer: Pingdingshan municipal government / operator to be determined
notes: Henan provincial government reported Pingdingshan's party secretary researched key projects at Baigui Lake Science and Innovation City and planned推进 intelligent computing center construction. A 2025 official reply also discusses the proposal to build a Lushan county/Pingdingshan municipal main-node intelligent computing center, including AI compute, general compute, high-performance storage, network, training and inference platforms. Electrical capacity not disclosed.

name: Puyang Big Data Center Project
developer: Puyang municipal government / China First Metallurgical Group construction
notes: Henan key-project summary lists the project in Puyang Urban-Rural Integration Demonstration Zone with 66,000 sq m construction, including IDC rooms, digital Puyang citizen experience hall, national-security information monitoring center, smart-city hub platform, and city data operations center. DTDATA reported main structure topping-out in 2022; Dahe Cube listed it as a 2025 Puyang key new-infrastructure project. Electrical capacity not disclosed.

name: Puyang Big Data Smart Park
developer: Puyang Big Data Smart Co., Ltd.
notes: Listed in 2024 and 2025 Henan key-project summaries in Puyang Urban-Rural Integration Demonstration Zone; 380,000 sq m gross floor area, including enterprise headquarters, innovation/data/smart buildings, convention facilities, apartments, a big data center, Baidu intelligent-transport innovation center, UBTECH AI research center, and support facilities. Electrical capacity not disclosed.

Searches found digital-government cloud/data-platform work and Lushi County smart-city infrastructure, but no clear public evidence of a datacenter, IDC, hyperscale, or computing-center facility in Sanmenxia division. Marked no_projects for datacenter coverage.

name: Shangqiu Computing Center Construction Project
developer: Shangqiu Yongxin Construction Development Co., Ltd.
notes: Public tender-plan reposts describe an estimated CNY 1.8019 billion project split into an intelligent computing center and AI industrial base. The computing center includes large-model computing center equipment, network equipment, platform software, immersion liquid-cooled cabinets, other computer-room equipment, and about 20,247.66 sq m renovation. Electrical capacity not disclosed.

name: Shangqiu Liangyuan Computing Center
notes: Reposted tender-plan/industry notes place the project in Liangyuan District with 100,000 sq m gross floor area, about 5000P computing scale, and facilities including computing buildings, an internet data center building, data storage building, and support buildings. Electrical capacity not disclosed.

name: Ningling JD Cloud (Central China) Data Center
developer: JD Cloud / local project company not specified
notes: Reposted project note says the Ningling County JD Cloud (Central China) Data Center would lease 126,000 sq m of standardized factory space, provide about 340P computing scale, and build plant and information-platform service center facilities. Electrical capacity not disclosed.
